blocks.text: The Primary Group of Builders, founded in Cebu in 1951, reaches its 75th anniversary this year, capping seven and a half decades of work that has touched housing, infrastructure, shipping, healthcare, and jobs across the province. The milestone matters because few local companies have remained active for this long, grown beyond the region, and continued to grow alongside the community that raised them. Over 75 years, Cebu has evolved from a regional trading center into one of the country’s leading economic hubs.
